item.tib: 'chi med ye gshen thugs kyis sprul pa gsang mchog rig pa mngon gyur sprul sku blo ldan snying po'i gsung 'bum las byang phyogs dur khrod mjal snang
item.coloph: de ltar rmi lam 'khrul snang 'di/ dkar chag yi ger btab pa yang / mkha' 'gro gnyen la bzod par gsol/ 'di bris dge ba'i mthu stobs kyis/ bdag sogs phyi rabs rjes 'breng rnams/ kha ba can gyi bod yul du/ bstan pa dar rgyas bkra shis shog/
